raw.message: Avoid using equals() to compare against null

reason: Direct generated record equals(null) contract is intentionally under test. JUnit assertNotEquals(null,value) or value!=null would not test target equality with null. Independent identity/type/all-component/constant hash/diagnostic/copy vectors provide substantive behavior, not filtered-code exclusion.
